name: assistant.provider_fingerprint
algorithm: hex(sha256(utf8('hkllm2|' + ascii_lower(strip_ascii_space(operator)) + '|' + lower(host(base_url)) + '|' + data_location + '|' + (data_location in ('lan','cell_private') ? '' : model))))
rules: strip_ascii_space: remove only U+0020 at both ends (Python: s.strip(' '); SQL: btrim(s, ' ')); never str.strip()
ascii_lower: map only A-Z to a-z (Python: s.translate(ASCII_LOWER); SQL: translate(...)); never str.lower() or PG lower(), which differ for characters such as U+0130

operator with a control character, tab, NBSP or other non-ASCII space, bidi or zero-width character (except ZWNJ) is rejected before hashing (SQL: assistant.is_clean_operator; CHECK on tenant_provider.operator)

model is part of the destination for 'iran' and 'other' (a reseller gateway serves domestic and resold foreign models on one host); for 'lan' and 'cell_private' the data never leaves the private network and the model is ignored
supersedes: assistant_fingerprint_v1.json (hkllm1, without model; kept only until section 09 switches platform.ai_provider_fingerprint to hkllm2)

vectors.note: same reseller host, different model => different destination => re-consent
LAN: port, path and model are not part of the destination
only ASCII letters are lowered: canonical operator is 'İstanbul ai'
